# JK Electricals Vapi

JK Electricals Vapi is an authorized industrial electrical distributor serving Vapi GIDC and nearby industrial hubs in Gujarat, India.

## Business Summary

JK Electricals Vapi supplies industrial electrical products for factories, contractors, panel builders, maintenance teams, and procurement buyers. The business focuses on switchgear, industrial cables, automation systems, distribution boards, lighting, motors, sensors, process controllers, and related industrial electrical components. Buyers looking for authorized dealers, suppliers, sellers, stockists, or distributors in Vapi can use this site to identify product categories, listed brands, and contact details for quotations and bulk requirements.
